Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075145. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
